bias_targets.methodology: Clustering human survey participants into distinct opinion groups based on their agreement/disagreement on subjective topics, and calculating an 'OVERTONSCORE' to measure the proportion of these distinct viewpoints adequately represented in LLM responses.

Evaluating model responses on politically salient questions and comparing the proposed pluralistic representation metric against established bipartisan political slant scores to analyze the relationship between political neutrality and ideological pluralism.

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Political subgroup bias (Gender, Ethnicity, Political Affiliation)
bias_targets.methodology: Testing for subgroup disparities in the automated LLM-as-a-judge's representation prediction errors (MAE and MSE) across participants' sex, ethnicity, and political affiliations using permutation ANOVA.
